name: Baked Beef Empanadas with Bean Salad

components.name: Beef Empanadas

ingredients.name: Hard-boiled egg, purchased raw weight edible egg (boil before filling)
Twelve purchased empanada pastry discs raw
Raw beaten egg wash no shell

steps: Hard boil filling eggs, cool, peel and chop. Heat oven to 200 C.
Sauté onion, pepper and garlic with oil. Brown the beef, stir through paste, cumin, paprika and salt, and simmer until filling is almost dry.
Cool filling thoroughly, then fold in chopped hard-boiled egg and olives.
Lay out twelve pastry discs, divide filling evenly, fold into half-moons and seal edges firmly using a fork or crimps; brush with beaten raw egg wash.
Divide two empanadas and one sixth of bean salad per lunch. Freeze empanadas alone; add fresh bean salad after reheating.

components.name: Black Bean Salad
steps: Bake 20-30 minutes until pastry is cooked through and golden. In parallel, toss drained beans, tomato, pepper, lime, oil and coriander for the cold side.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Original Argentinian baked empanada technique plus UNHANGRY measured bean salad to make a full dinner. Dough is store-bought to shorten prep.
Planning: SECONDARY STOVETOP: make filling and boil eggs. Store bean salad cold separately.
Freezer: baked empanadas freeze well; salad better fresh for 1-3 days
Dietary: Contains wheat, eggs; pastry may contain dairy.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
